name: Rob, junior organiser
text: We had one dad who brought a folding chair and a flask and sat at the net post. At the NET POST. We moved the session to the far court and he moved the chair.

name: Anonymous
text: I am the parent on the fence. I have read this twice. I will be bringing trainers.

author: terry
text: In my day parents dropped you off and went to Homebase. Worked fine. Mel, the pickleball court is MY court, as you well know.

author: jake
text: Mel, run the parents' session as a [Rallio mixer](https://rallio.io/mixers/) and send the link round the junior parents' group. They sign up on their phones, you see how many are coming before Saturday, and it mixes the doubles each round so the same two dads don't end up playing each other all morning.
